subject.title: perf(sessions): stop cloning the whole store per catalog request

question: Should the session-catalog snapshot expose and share one mutable-typed flattened array across catalog providers under the documented no-mutation contract?
rationale: This is an internal plugin/catalog seam with compatibility implications for existing provider implementations; code review alone cannot establish the intended long-term borrowing contract.

options.title: Approve the shared snapshot contract
options.body: Confirm that catalog providers are required to treat the request entries as read-only and accept the request-wide flattening optimization after runtime proof is added.

options.title: Preserve provider-local result isolation
options.body: Keep the lazy cache projection but return isolated provider arrays if the existing plugin contract must permit callers to reorder or mutate the wrapper result.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared snapshot contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that catalog providers are required to treat the request entries as read-only and accept the request-wide flattening optimization after runtime proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged adjacent cache work and this follow-up place this person closest to the session cache and catalog snapshot contract.
